description:
Fuel is scored as a daily pass/fail: totals reset at local midnight and the meters (FuelPanel.tsx:138-163) say "hit" or "384 kcal left". Physiology does not settle up daily. Every serious tracker reports the weekly average, because one high day inside a compliant week is noise, and seven mediocre days that each read "close" are not.

Add a 7-day rolling average line to the fuel history view (GET /api/fuel/history already returns per-day totals, fuel.ts:128-160) and show, under the daily meters, "this week: 2,480 kcal/day avg, 172 g protein/day avg" against the target that was in force. Days with zero entries are a real problem here: an unlogged day averages in as 0 and makes adherence look far better than it was. Count and show them ("6 of 7 days logged") and exclude unlogged days from the average rather than treating them as fasts.

Feeds T-025 (streaks) — the honest streak is logged days, not target-hit days.
title: Score fuel on a weekly average, not a daily pass/fail
